text: K2 ends with map coordinates. Read as digits and repeated under the message, they could be a second key added to a repeating word: two keys, but the second one known.
Taking the digit off each known place leaves the word's letter forced outright. Across 29,232 cases (readings, alignments, sign, word length), no word shorter than 26 letters fits.
The best forced word scores -5.58 as English, no better than on a shuffled copper. The coordinates are not a numeric key of this kind.
